items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: Yeah, I remember Don. I saw him last night.

ctx.x: I got it on my mind. Yeah. Do you remember there were some kids from Florida, I think, in the radio, a studying radio or something, and they made some tapes up here back in 1950 at American Legion at the Plum Plant. No, I think you don't. And I wonder whatever happened to those tapes. I'd love to find that again. I like to hear that. I like to get the light, get a copy of it. They were friends of Don Harris.
Yeah, I remember Don. I saw him last night.

He's doing okay. He's working at WDSU TV. Is it late? Yeah, he runs a motion picture projector and stuff. You know, he was always like tape machines and motion picture projectors and stuff like that. So he's there. I saw him last night and he might have to tell us what happened to those kids. And who came to the American Legion there? I mean, we had Don and me and a few people. Nick. Who? Nick?
